labels.variantDefinition: Explains the source or inspiration (historical artefact, technology, place) in short prose, paired with the source or with the type evoking it
labels.look: Black, glossy 3D-rendered MICR-style numerals, small prose column on the left
labels.learn: Render the numerals as physical objects to make an abstract origin (magnetic ink) tangible

labels.variantDefinition: Style dropdown plus category tabs (lowercase, uppercase, numerals…) switching a large-size strip of glyphs
labels.look: White, giant black serif glyphs cropped by the viewport, minimal tab bar
labels.ux: Style dropdown, category tabs; glyphs probably scroll sideways
labels.learn: Showing glyphs huge, a few at a time, beats a tiny full grid for appreciating a text serif

labels.variantDefinition: One big sample line with a panel of OpenType feature toggles (caps, dlig, ss01…) that switch alternates live
labels.look: Magenta field, mint 3D-extruded 'TRY ME', black-and-white toggle switches with feature tags
labels.ux: Toggle MATE, CAPS, DLIG, SS01, SS02; slider; editable text
labels.learn: Label toggles with the real feature tags (DLIG, SS01): teaches OpenType vocabulary while playing

labels.variantDefinition: Each variable axis gets its own word, slider and short explanation, so axes are understood one at a time
labels.look: Lavender, words 'Inktrap', 'Balloon', 'Curve' each in its axis extreme, thin sliders, captions
labels.learn: Name each axis after what it does, and show it on a word that names itself

labels.variantDefinition: The typefaces set in a real or realistic editorial product (magazine, newspaper, articles), with genuine content
labels.look: White, large serif headline 'This Is Love: A Riff on the Jamaican Patty', section label, byline
labels.learn: Commission real writing: the specimen becomes a publication people actually read

labels.look: Dark card with blackletter text about George Shelley and the Gutenberg Bible, wax seal photo, dot pagination
labels.learn: Telling the inspiration in the typeface itself (blackletter) doubles as a text specimen

labels.variantDefinition: Single words or short phrases at display size stacked vertically, often cropped by the viewport, to show character and rhythm
labels.look: Grey and white bands, large expressive serif words cropped at the edges, black nav bar
labels.learn: Cropping display words at the viewport edge makes a static specimen feel in motion

labels.variantDefinition: A bento grid of cards, each showing one slice of the character set or one feature (arrows, numerals, ligatures), sometimes with tiny toggles
labels.look: Black, big 'Qq&', alphabet block, arrow set, numerals, white cards with ligature toggles, exponential-graph figures
labels.learn: Cards let you show many feature slices without a monotonous grid

labels.variantDefinition: A realistic in-use layout (classified ads, menu, poster) whose text the visitor can edit; tester and showcase in one
labels.look: Newspaper 'Classifieds' page, mixed Prospectus sizes and italics, red accent
labels.ux: Editable classified ads ('Wanted: someone to edit the following')
labels.learn: Give the tester a premise: 'edit these classifieds' invites play more than an empty field
